ns2:course.label: Intro Elec & Comp Engrg
ns2:course.description: (ECE 110) Integrated introduction to selected fundamental concepts and principles in electrical and computer engineering: circuits, electromagnetics, communications, electronics, controls, and computing. Laboratory experiments and lectures focus on a design and construction project, such as an autonomous moving vehicle. Prerequisite: Credit or registration in either MATH 220 or MATH 235.
